question: Mohan sold 153 chairs and had a gain equal to the selling price of 68 chairs. What is his profit percentage?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the Selling Price (SP) of 1 chair be ₹1.

Total Selling Price of 153 chairs = ₹153

Profit = Selling Price of 68 chairs = ₹68

Cost Price (CP) of 153 chairs = SP − Profit = 153 − 68 = ₹85

Profit Percentage = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100 = (68 ÷ 85) × 100 = 80%

**∴ The correct answer is 80%.**
